sources.title: Xylo™: Ultra-low power neuromorphic chip | SynSense
sources.snippet: The Xylo™ series is a globally leading ultra-low-power neuromorphic computing chip designed to process bioelectrical signals like EMG and EEG. Serving as the "intelligent brain" for next-generation interactive devices, it leverages a unique Spiking Recurrent Neural Network algorithm and a fully parallel, event-driven architecture to deliver real-time, high-precision neural signal ...

sources.title: SynSense launches the Xylo™ IMU neuromorphic HDK
sources.snippet: The Xylo™ IMU dev kit enables users to develop IMU-based motion processing applications such as human movement analysis and industrial monitoring.

sources.title: A Look at Xylo - SynSense - Neuromorphic Chip - Open Neuromorphic
sources.snippet: Xylo is a series of ultra-low-power devices for sensory inference, featuring a digital SNN core adaptable to various sensory inputs like audio and bio-signals. Its SNN core uses an integer-logic CuBa-LIF neuron model with customizable parameters for each synapse and neuron, supporting a wide range of network architectures.
